power: Battery power throughout the macOS measurement set; no charger connected. Thermal state nominal at the start and at the end of the preview process.
conditions: One process measured all five fixtures sequentially, without a debugger and without overlapping benchmark runs. Power, thermals, and background activity are not controlled.
visual_inspection: Sample 1 of all five fixtures inspected with Apple Vision text recognition over the PNG: heading, prose, mention, task list, and quote text are present for ordinary and the large fixtures; quote and list levels are present for nested; the table header and first-column cells are present for links/tables.
